An independent presidency backed by changing parliamentary allies, united around Makarios and the defence of the republic.
Spyros Kyprianou announced the Democratic Alignment on 12 May 1976 to support Makarios. The presidency and the new parliamentary organization remain distinct offices.
The Democratic Alignment adopted the Democratic Party name on 4 December 1976. Makarios remains the independent president while Spyros Kyprianou leads DIKO.
The Democratic Party represents the presidential centre under Spyros Kyprianou, seeking continuity, international support and a settlement of the Cyprus dispute.
Glafkos Clerides leads the United Party, formed in 1969. The party brings together the republican right of the early 1970s.
Glafkos Clerides founded Democratic Rally on 4 July 1976. The party brings together the republican right around Clerides and a negotiated settlement.
EDEK — United Democratic Union of Centre
Vassos Lyssarides's movement emerged in 1969 and held its founding congress on 3 May 1970. The contemporary EDEK name predates the later Movement for Social Democracy name.
EDEK adopted socialist terminology at its second congress in April 1974, combining democratic socialism with resistance to the coup and the partition of Cyprus.
AKEL — Progressive Party of Working People
AKEL is the established Cypriot communist party, led by Ezekias Papaioannou. Its programme emphasizes organized labour, public services and Cypriot independence.

Rauf Denktaş took the vice-presidential oath and the leadership of the Turkish Cypriot administration on 28 February 1973. A local administration is not equivalent to international recognition.
Ulusal Birlik Partisi was founded on 11 October 1975. Rauf Denktaş's presidency is distinct from the successive party chairmanships and premierships of Konuk, Örek, Çağatay and Eroğlu.

The opposition tendency predates an organized CTP. Ahmet Mithat Berberoğlu's Republican Turkish Party is founded only on 27 December 1970.

Cumhuriyetçi Türk Partisi was founded on 27 December 1970. Ahmet Mithat Berberoğlu is its first chair; Özker Özgür leads the later 1976–1996 period. The party advocates democratic representation, workers' rights and a negotiated settlement.
